description: Browse participating ATA properties without stay dates. Filter by location, property type, amenities, views, or keyword. Does not check date-specific availability or prices.

adults.description: Optional adults for occupancy-safe catalog suggestions.

children.description: Optional children for occupancy-safe catalog suggestions.

keyword.description: Text matched against property name/description. Use for a required text match; use preferences for optional style preferences.

location.description: City, state, or country to filter by. Omit to search all participating ATA destinations.

maxResults.description: Max number of properties to return (default 10)

preferences.description: Open-ended soft ranking signals inferred from traveler language or current network facets.

name: search_property_catalog
